title: Global Merit Chain (GMChain) Protocol Draft Schema
description: Normative data structures for GMChain single-layer coFay ownership, unbounded Nested Merit Chain derivation, 1:1 OrganizationID binding, natural-person Steward accountability, and zero-floor (B_i = 0) cold-start bootstrap Merit batches.

OrganizationID.description: Canonical FayID Organization identifier (<prefix>_<base32> or DNS-safe slug).

IFayID.description: Canonical FayID individual digital avatar identifier (Ed25519 Holder-of-Key).

CoFayID.description: Canonical FayID collective/role digital avatar identifier.

OpaqueRef.description: Privacy-preserving commitment handle anchoring natural-person quota and concave voting normalization without exposing HumanID.

FixedDecimal.description: Deterministic fixed-point decimal string (6 fractional decimal places max).

OwnerRef.description: Offline-verifiable single-layer owner reference. Only HumanID or OrganizationID may own a coFay; iFay and coFay are forbidden as owners.

CoFayOwnershipRecord.description: Flat single-layer coFay ownership record. Excludes any ancestor path or ownership depth.

delegates.description: Active operational Delegate VerifyingKey fingerprints or delegated iFay managers (granting operational authority without altering ownership).

NestedMeritChainRecord.description: Derived Nested Merit Chain record in Chain_Registry. Enforces unbounded protocol depth, optional 1:1 OrganizationID projection, and natural-person Stewards.

derivationPath.description: Ordered path starting at gmc-base with no fixed protocol-level maximum depth.

stewards.description: Accountable natural-person Stewards (HumanID required; iFay and coFay forbidden).

managers.description: Delegated operational chain managers (iFay avatars); orthogonal to Steward accountability.

BootstrapMeritBatch.description: Cold-start one-way bootstrap MeriToken batch. Enforces B_i = 0 (zero floor contribution, never raising minMerit), >= 2x faster decay, and per-opaqueRef caps.

b.description: Immutable protocol invariant: cold-start bootstrap batches contribute strictly 0 to permanent floor minMerit.

decayMultiplier.description: Accelerated decay factor relative to earned contribution baseline (>= 2; conservative preset = 3, neutral preset = 2).

GovernanceVoterSlice.description: Per-iFay governance voting input aggregated by opaqueRef prior to concave square-root weighting.
